# Video

Create short video clips from a description of the scene and camera: reels, TikToks, shorts, ads, intros and stories. Generated with Kling, Veo, Seedance, Wan and more.

## What it does
Describe the scene, action and camera movement. Claude picks a model (Kling 3.0 by default; Veo, Seedance, Wan and others on request), tells you the price, and creates the clip. Clips take one to a few minutes.

**How the files are made:** The files are generated by image, video and audio models that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you ask, and the price in credits is shown first.

Clips of a few seconds each; 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 depending on the model.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install video@megascenes
```

## Setup
The plugin connects Claude to the MegaScenes MCP server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/video/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting asks you to sign in to MegaScenes (OAuth with PKCE); you can create an account on the same page, and you come straight back to the chat.
- Creating uses the credits on your MegaScenes account, and the price is shown before anything runs. New accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- Where Claude supports interactive apps, results appear in a live viewer; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_video_models` | Models for videos with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_video_cost` | Exact price of one video before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_video` | Starts one video in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_video` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A 5-second 9:16 shot of a barista pouring latte art, slow motion"
- "Drone shot over a misty mountain lake at sunrise, 16:9"
- "A product reveal of white sneakers spinning on a pedestal"

## Data and privacy
Your prompts, settings and the files you choose are sent to MegaScenes and kept in your MegaScenes account, and they are sent to the model provider that makes the file. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
